nodes.name: secretary-turn.blade.php
nodes.summary: Blade component that renders the secretary's spoken message in a centered, styled paragraph for the conversation UI.

nodes.name: talk-control.blade.php
nodes.summary: Voice recording control component combining Alpine.js talkControl with a toggle button, animated listening bars, and upload URL wiring to the voice-turns store endpoint.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses wire:ignore to isolate Alpine state from Livewire DOM diffing while posting audio via the talkControl JavaScript module.

nodes.name: app.blade.php
nodes.summary: Primary application HTML layout loading Vite assets, setting locale-aware metadata, and rendering page content through a slot with dark-themed body styling.

nodes.name: conversation.blade.php
nodes.summary: Livewire conversation page view showing secretary messages, transcription status/errors, and the talk-control widget with conditional polling while a voice turn is processing.

nodes.name: welcome.blade.php
nodes.summary: Default Laravel welcome landing page with embedded Tailwind fallback styles, auth navigation links, and marketing hero content for unauthenticated visitors.
nodes.languageNotes: Inlines a full Tailwind v4 stylesheet when Vite build artifacts are absent, making the file unusually large for a Blade template.

nodes.name: console.php
nodes.summary: Artisan route definitions registering the inspire demo command that prints a random motivational quote via the console.

nodes.name: Pest.php
nodes.summary: Pest bootstrap that binds feature tests to the Laravel TestCase and enables LazilyRefreshDatabase only for tests under the Feature directory.

nodes.name: TestCase.php
nodes.summary: Abstract base test case extending Laravel's foundation TestCase, serving as the shared parent for feature tests configured in Pest.php.

nodes.name: TestCase
nodes.summary: Abstract application test case that subclasses Laravel's foundation TestCase for use by Pest feature tests.

nodes.name: ExampleTest.php
nodes.summary: Placeholder Pest unit test asserting a trivial truth value, demonstrating the default unit test setup without Laravel application bootstrapping.

nodes.name: vite.config.js
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration wiring the Laravel plugin, Tailwind CSS, Instrument Sans font loading, and frontend entry points for app.css and app.js.
